notes: Summary: Saffron is a global BPO running 24/7 multi-tenant contact centers supporting retail and telecom customers. They need a Dedicated capacity solution to guarantee predictable throughput during daily peaks and seasonal spikes (notably a big retail peak in November). Primary goals: agent assist with sub-120ms p95 latency, real-time tool-calling (CRM actions via LLM), and automated summarization for ticket handoffs. Security: must meet SOC2, SSO/SAML integration, customer-specific data residency for EU accounts, and KMS-based key management. Quote from CTO on 09/04: "We cannot afford noisy neighbor behavior — need rack-level isolation and deterministic tail latency." POC notes: demo showed good baseline throughput but identified a warm-cache regression when agents switch contexts rapidly; SE recommended prefix caching and proactive KV prefetch. Commercial: target ARR in the 200k-500k band depending on SLA credits and burst capacity pricing. Next actions: finalize SOW with explicit latency SLOs, legal to accept isolation language, schedule network peering and KMS pilot. Conversations are fast-moving; procurement reviews by mid-Jan expected.
use_case_summary: Primary workloads are live agent assist (low-latency generation with tool-calling hooks into CRM), automated ticket summarization for post-call wrap, and reranking for suggested responses. Throughput expectation: sustained 500 concurrent agents during peak with headroom for 2x seasonal spikes. Cost sensitivity moderate — willing to pay premium for guaranteed p95 SLA and isolation. Wants deterministic fallbacks and routing policies to lower-tier model if capacity constrained.
